description: Every perp on Lighter on Robinhood Chain scored -100 to +100 from its trend on 1h and 4h, the day's move in daily ATRs, its strength against BTC (crypto) or QQQ (stocks) over a week, and the volume behind it; with signals (runner, breakout, breakdown, leads or lags, divergence against the move, squeeze or flush risk) and whether the move is real (volume and open interest behind it, both timeframes agreeing).
name: market_screener
title: Every Lighter RH perp, scored
